title: Hybrid beast
author: Syed Sakib  H.
desc:
• This 3 day/week spilt is a hybrid combining two of my favourite splits for hypertrophy;that is,the push pull legs split and the sliver era inspired full body splits .



• The program let's you train each body part except for legs at a twice/week frequency and if you want massive tree trunks which I don't then you can include two leg exercises 2 sets each on your first day of the week.

• The program is for intermediate lifters helps you build muscle but also more work capacity for your advance stage.



• EACH FULL BODY DAY HAS A BASE TAKEN FROM THE CONVENTIONAL PPL , eg: first day is most focused on chest but also allows for some back volume and legs if you want and the second day is just your conventional back and bicep day and the third is your leg focused chest and shoulder day .

ENJOY YOUR GAINS.

ex.note: Do two sets with close nuteral grip and two with wide grip if you want to emphasize more back width then replace by either pulldowns or weighted pull-ups.
Do it with a slow controlled tempo emphasize the weighted stretch.
Make sure to keep you back as straight as possible and your chest out streching the abs and slowing going down on the eccentric.
Do three rest pause sets start with your first set let's say you get 8 reps then wait 30 secs then do it again this time you should get half of what you got on your first then repeat one more time
First two sets with a close neutral grip then next two with wide grip.

Do three myo matched sets i,e; lets say you get 10 reps on first set and it is complete failure the on the next set say you got 8 Now wait for 5 secs then do it again till you second set matches first
Do a slow very controlled rep then on the bottom of each rep stretch you traps .
Do it in a Smith machine and also elevate your feet on some thing to get an even massive stretch at the bottom
Do it rest pause style
